# FontMetrics

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides font metrics for calculating text width in PDF documents. Supports both standard PDF fonts and custom TTF fonts.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`GetStringWidth`](#getstringwidth): Gets the width of a text string in points
- [`RegisterFontAlias`](#registerfontalias): Registers a logical font name alias pointing to a specific TTF file path.

### `GetStringWidth`

```csharp
float GetStringWidth(string text, string fontIdentifier, float fontSize, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> features = null)
```

*static*

Gets the width of a text string in points

- `text`: The text to measure
- `fontIdentifier`: Font name (e.g., "Helvetica") or TTF file path (e.g., "C:/Fonts/arial.ttf")
- `fontSize`: The font size in points

### `RegisterFontAlias`

```csharp
void RegisterFontAlias(string logicalName, string ttfPath)
```

*static*

Registers a logical font name alias pointing to a specific TTF file path. Should be called by PdfResourceRegistry when PDF/A mode maps a standard font to an embedded TTF. Ensures `GetStringWidth` measures using actual TTF glyph metrics rather than the approximate standard-font width tables, so layout matches rendering.
